summary: A small colored pill label that shows a health status such as normal, warning or critical.
purpose: Lets patients see at a glance whether a value is fine, borderline or a concern.
why: Header says semantic status indicators for health data. The color is tied to the meaning of the status.
how: Defines colors for normal, warning, critical, info and neutral statuses, and three sizes. The default is neutral and medium. Renders a rounded pill in the chosen colors and passes any other props through.
inputs: Status, size, children, and the usual div props.
risks: A missing or misspelled status falls back to neutral grey with no warning, so a critical value passed in wrong would look harmless. Color alone carries the meaning, which can be hard for colorblind users.
debug: If the color is wrong, check the status value is spelled exactly as listed. If the size looks off, check the size value.
